title: Geometry Relaxation of Germanane
action: Construct a 5x5x1 supercell of hydrogenated germanene (germanane) with the buckled structure (Ge-H bond length ≈ 1.56 Å, Ge-Ge ≈ 2.47 Å). Perform full geometry relaxation using SIESTA with GGA/PBE and a double-zeta polarized (DZP) basis set until forces are converged.

title: Adsorption Calculations and Band Structure Analysis
action: For each of the six adsorbates (formaldehyde, acetaldehyde, propionaldehyde, methanol, ethanol, 1-propanol), build the adsorbed system on the relaxed germanane, perform full geometry optimization, compute adsorption energy with BSSE correction, Mulliken and AIM charge transfer, and compute band structure to extract band gap. Also compute band gap of isolated relaxed germanane. Compile all results into adsorption_results.csv.
description: CSV file with computed band gaps and adsorption energies for isolated germanane and six adsorbed systems.
